lens: Skyhook: finance, program and canon tools
title: Required Life
tagline: Not how long HMPE will last at 28–40% of break, which nobody in the repo knows, but how long it must last before creep-governed replacement breaks the conservative case, with DM20 vs SK78 as a labelled multiplier on the one anchored datum.
pitch: DECISION_LOG item 10 names three admissible outcomes for the creep hard part and the first is 'creep-governed tether replacement cadence, costed into ops' — nothing in finance/ costs it. This page adds a replacement line to the conservative cash flow and runs it backwards. Inputs: the EQ-6 fiber mass per tier and column; the HMPE share of tether mass (no canonical value exists; the page offers a length-based estimate from the founding doc's 'UHMWPE for the bulk of each arm, outer ~20 km of the lower arm in Zylon' and labels it [Speculative]); replacement life in years, with a single anchored tick at 'SK78 ≈ 8 yr at 20% load, 20 °C [secondary guidance, MP-001 §1]' and a DM20 toggle that multiplies that tick by the LR-001 '>50× slower' factor and nothing else; cost per replaced kg = construction launch $/kg from the ladder plus fiber $/kg, which is null in rev_a.json and therefore shown as an unpriced gap unless the user sets a bracket. Forward view: annual replacement cost as a share of fixed ops and of mature revenue, and the payback year with the line added. The main kernel is the inverse: the life L* at which payback slips one year, and the life at which replacement equals the $80M fixed-ops line, per tier. The closing sentence is always of the form 'the program needs ≥ L* years at 28–40% load; the only anchored point is 8 yr at 20%; the gap is what ST-002 and TP-001 must measure'. It never prints a predicted life.
whyNow: docs/DECISION_LOG.md item 10 ('Admissible outcomes (not yet decided): (a) creep-governed tether replacement cadence, costed into ops; (b) hybrid boundary shifted toward PBO; (c) HMPE grade change — DM20-class is reported to creep >50× slower than SK78'; 'Downstream actions ... risk register row update; TP-001 scope addition'); docs/research/mp001_market_pricing.md §3c and §1 row 'HMPE creep guidance'; docs/research/lr001_splice_literature.md §D; finance/skyhook_finance.py has only a flat fixed_ops_M with no replacement term; docs/project_instructions.md line 108 for the hybrid description.
computes: Inputs: rev_a.json materials (σ, ρ, SF), kinematics tiers (2.5/2.8/3.5), ladder.json (launch $/kg, fixed ops, revenue inputs), f_HMPE in [0,1], life L in years, optional fiber $/kg. Math: fiber mass from EQ-6 as the finance model does; annual replacement $M = f_HMPE × fiber kg × (launch $/kg + fiber $/kg) ÷ L, added to opex from Y5 (the page states this treats replacement as an operating line, a convention); payback and NPV as in the finance model; inverse by bisection on L for payback(L) = 18 (one year worse than 17) and for replacement = fixed ops. DM20 toggle: anchored tick 8 yr -> 400 yr, drawn as a second tick, not applied to the slider value. Refusals: fiber $/kg unset -> that term absent and a visible 'unpriced' badge (mirrors finance/inspace_fork.py require_non_null); f_HMPE unset -> no result until chosen.
dataNeeded: rev_a.json --pick materials,kinematics,economics,geometry (3 KB); ladder.json (1 KB); creep_constants.json holding the three secondary numbers (28–40% sustained load, 8 yr at 20%, >50× for DM20) copied from docs/research/mp001_market_pricing.md §1 and §3c and lr001_splice_literature.md §D with line references and their [Likely]/secondary labels, sidecar-only (1 KB).
existingOverlap: No repo module costs replacement cadence; the field kit's ST-002 log records elongation but no economics; finance/skyhook_finance.py has no replacement line; the risk register has no creep row. The decision log explicitly marks the outcome 'not yet decided', so a study that frames the required life is the next step rather than a duplicate.
honestyRisks: Inventing a creep law (Vlasblom–Bosman or a power law) to turn 28–40% load into a life — refused: life is an input and the output is a requirement. The DM20 factor and the 8-year datum are secondary-sourced — labelled on the control itself. The HMPE mass fraction is unknown — chooser with the derivation visible and [Speculative]. EQ-6 is single-material (Zylon σ/ρ for the whole tether, as rev_a.json does) — stated as the canonical simplification, with the note that an HMPE-bulk hybrid has a different V_c. Idea-bank fidelity; not a design number.
testPlan: node --test: with replacement off the conservative triple is reproduced ($8,741M / Y17 / −$3,883M); hand check f=1, L=8, launch $2,500, fiber unset: 609.1304 t × 1000 × 2500 / 8 / 1e6 = $190.35M/yr; inverse solver satisfies payback(L*) = 18 and payback(L*+0.01) = 17; replacement cost is monotone decreasing in L and linear in f; DM20 toggle moves only the anchored tick (slider value unchanged); fiber price unset -> term absent and badge present; smoke at 390 px.
landing: Skyhook finance/creep_cadence.py with CREEP_CADENCE_FINDINGS.md (Python port of the same arithmetic, reconciliation-gated like rightsize_sensitivity.py), feeding the creep row of tools/financial/skyhook_risk_register.xlsx and the TP-001 creep series scope. To ship: a sourced creep-life datum (ST-002 coupon ratio, TP-001, or a rope-maker dataset) and Hudson's choice of HMPE fraction and replacement convention.
notes: Item 10 outcome (a) has no cost line in finance/; verified MP-001 §1 '8 yr at 20 %' and LR-001 §D '>50×'. Inverting to required life rather than predicting life is the right refusal.
